title: Reckoner hero (v2)
description: A full-window merlot screen with one huge, regular-weight linen headline set about a third of the way down (110px on desktop, 48px on phones), two square buttons under it, a small news link and a 'scroll' cue at the bottom whose little arrows stream downwards on a loop, and a faint vertical label at the right edge. A full-bleed artwork slot sits behind everything.
notes: uses the primary colour as its surface: pair it with reckoner-v2-header, which floats over it
100svh tall; the background slot is cropped to it like object-fit: cover (empty: a soft highlight wash, a placeholder)
the scroll cue's loop is CSS only and stops under reduced motion
